messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'r4-prod-us' saturation detected. queue_growth=+420%, avg_wait=18s, running_gpus=96/96, autoscaler=ERROR (scale_up failed: quota_exceeded). Pager routed to eng-sre and eng-platform at 2026-03-15T14:22:30Z

sara: I'm on it. looking at autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated 403 from cloud API when requesting new nodes.

alex: paging infra on quota? @morgan can you check quotas in the cloud account?

morgan: on it. checking quota and recent deletes. quick note: there was a scheduled maintenance window earlier but shouldn't affect GPU quotas.

sara: root cause candidate: autoscale attempted to provision 16 gpus but cloud returned quota_exceeded. autoscaler didn't gracefully fallback, queue kept growing and we hit per-pool throttle.

toby: customers: some requests started 5xx or long tail >10s. CS showing a spike in error reports for hosted inference. @customer-ops are we tracking impacted customers?

customer-ops: yes — 3 enterprise customers reported degraded responses for ~22m starting ~14:20 UTC. Triage note saved in GDrive: https://drive.redwood.ai/incidents/1768201350-impact

alex: mitigation attempt 1: manual scale-up failed (cloud API returns quota error). mitigation attempt 2: draining low-priority queue and applying token-based throttling to free capacity. executing now.

sara: running commands to re-route non-critical traffic to overflow region 'us-west-backup':
```
# reroute non-prod & free-tier traffic
infractl route set --pool r4-prod-us --route lowprio=us-west-backup
# apply throttles
infractl throttle add --pool r4-prod-us --policy lowprio=30pct
```

morgan: quota team says there's an outstanding pending quota request, but not approved yet. we can temporarily up to 8 gpus if we open emergency request — i'll open and wedge with support.

eng-platform-bot: Deploy started: autoscaler-patch/2026-03-15-14:35. Patch introduces fallback to reduce requested nodes when quota_exceeded and fall back to warm-pool.

sara: deploying patch to autoscaler config to handle quota_exceeded gracefully (reduce batch size and retry). rolling now.

alex: good. also enabling KV-cache warmers to reduce token compute for hot sessions.

oncritical-throttle-bot: Applied policy lowprio=30pct to r4-prod-us at 14:36 UTC. Expected queue reduction in 3-5 min.

sara: monitoring... queue length trending down from 420% to 150% in 10min. avg latency down to 6s.

morgan: emergency quota approved for +8 gpus in region, available now. starting manual scale for 8 gpus to the pool.

alex: manual scale command:
```
infractl pool scale r4-prod-us --add 8 --type p4d
```

sara: added 8 gpus, pool at 104/104 now. queue settling. autoscaler patch accepted, will continue retry loop with reduced batch size.

customer-ops: CS update sent at 14:58 UTC: "We've mitigated the issue and are continuing to monitor. Some customers experienced elevated latency and errors between 14:20-14:50 UTC. Follow-up via account teams."

toby: logging notes for postmortem: timeline, root cause = autoscaler didn't handle cloud quota_exceeded, lack of graceful degrade path, missing warm-pool size config, missing prioritized request routing. Impact = ~3 enterprise accounts with degraded latency/errors, approx 22m outage window. Mitigations = reroute low-priority traffic, apply throttles, manual quota emergency and scale, autoscaler patch.

sara: adding immediate action items: 
- add unit test & e2e for autoscaler to simulate quota_exceeded and ensure fallback (owner: eng-platform)
- tune warm-pool baseline for r4-prod-us to 10% capacity (owner: eng-runtime)
- add alert for quota_exceeded errors from cloud API as S1 (owner: eng-infra)
- update runbook with manual reroute and throttle commands (owner: eng-sre)

alex: tagging P0 postmortem. assigning owners in our PM tracker. I'll kick off doc draft.

morgan: cloud support ticket: SR#20260315-91234. saved. note: request to increase soft quota to avoid repeated emergency requests.

eng-platform-bot: Autoscaler metrics baseline updated. patch rolled to prod-canary at 15:02 UTC.

sara: last checks: error rate back to normal for most customers, backlog drained. marking incident stabilized at 15:10 UTC.

customer-ops: final customer update queued for 15:20 UTC.

alex: postmortem TODOs captured. will schedule RCA working session tomorrow 09:00 UTC. please add any additional notes here.

morgan: note to infra: request permanent quota bump for r4-prod-us or enable autoscale to fall back to alternate region automatically (owner: infra).

sara: adding a follow-up: run load test against fallback routing to validate latencies and cold-start behavior. (owner: eng-sre).

toby: thanks team. nice quick mitigations. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident stabilized. Recording incident summary to /incidents/1768201350/summary and creating postmortem placeholder.
